_readme: imPress error catalogue: every error code, in categories, each with a description and what to do.
HTTP responses carry the code in `error.code` (and the X-Impress-Error header); the console and start-up use the same names.
`http` is 0 for things that are not HTTP responses (exit codes, hardware faults).
The tests keep it complete: a code raised anywhere in the backend that is not listed here fails the build.

http.about: Generic HTTP outcomes, used when a route gives no more specific code.

errors.title: The request could not be understood
errors.description: The request was malformed or a value was not acceptable.
errors.fix: Read the message, correct the request and send it again.

errors.title: Not signed in
errors.description: The request carries no valid session or token, or the session ended (idle limit, hard limit, signed out, server restarted: 1PSID).

errors.title: Not allowed
errors.description: You are signed in, but your role does not hold the permission this needs.
errors.fix: Ask an administrator, or use an account with the right role.

errors.title: Not found
errors.description: The thing asked for does not exist, or you may not know that it exists.

errors.title: Method not allowed
errors.description: The route exists, but not for this HTTP method.
errors.fix: Use the method the API reference lists.

errors.title: Conflict with the current state
errors.description: The request cannot be done in the state things are in (a duplicate, or someone else changed it first).

errors.title: No longer available
errors.description: It existed and was removed (for example a one-time link that was used).

errors.title: Too large
errors.description: An upload or request body is larger than the limit.
errors.fix: Send less data, or split it.

errors.title: A value is not valid
errors.description: A field is missing, has the wrong type or is outside its allowed range. `detail` lists each field.

errors.title: Too many requests
errors.description: Too many attempts in a short time (sign-in, step-up, an unusually busy client).
errors.fix: Wait for the time in the Retry-After header.

errors.title: Something went wrong inside imPress
errors.description: An unexpected fault. Nothing was partly saved: database work is transactional. The server log has the trace under the reference shown.
errors.fix: Retry once; if it repeats, give the reference to whoever runs the server.

errors.title: Not implemented
errors.description: The server does not support what was asked.

errors.title: Temporarily unavailable
errors.description: The server cannot serve this right now (start-up checks, a lock-down, the database busy).

authentication.about: Signing in and out, passwords and sessions.

errors.title: Wrong username or password
errors.description: The pair does not match an account. The response never says which one is wrong.
errors.fix: Check both; after several failures there is a wait (TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS).

errors.title: Too many failed sign-ins
errors.description: The username or the client address has failed too often in 15 minutes; the wait doubles with each failure (no permanent lock-out).
errors.fix: Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After.

errors.title: Account is disabled
errors.description: An administrator disabled this account.
errors.fix: Ask an administrator to enable it.

errors.title: Already signed in on another device
errors.description: One device per account: another live session exists. The attempt is flagged and administrators are told.
errors.fix: Sign out on the other device, wait for it to expire, or ask a super admin to end sessions.

errors.title: Choose your own password first
errors.description: The account has temporary credentials (pending set-up); only the first-sign-in steps are allowed.

errors.title: That password is not acceptable
errors.description: It breaks the password rule for the role (length, upper and lower case, a number, a special character, not common, not the username).
errors.fix: Choose a stronger password; the strength meter shows what is missing.

errors.title: The session ended
errors.description: Idle limit (15 minutes, 60 for faculty in class), the 6-hour hard limit, a sign-out, a role change or a server restart ended it.

errors.title: Use HTTPS
errors.description: Staff traffic must arrive over HTTPS unless the client is on the server itself (REQUIRE_HTTPS).

errors.title: Only a super admin can change roles
errors.description: Granting or removing an administrative role needs users.assign_role.

errors.title: Only a super admin can manage a super admin
errors.description: Administrators cannot touch super admin accounts.

errors.title: A protected account
errors.description: The default super admin is managed by root: it cannot be deleted, demoted, deactivated or have its password reset through the API.

errors.title: You cannot do that to your own account
errors.description: Deactivating, deleting or demoting yourself would lock you out.

errors.title: Super admins are created in the console
errors.description: The web app and the API cannot create a super admin.
errors.fix: Root runs `superadmin create USER` in the console.

errors.title: Not a student you teach
errors.description: Faculty see and change only students enrolled in their classes.

errors.title: The database gateway refused the write
errors.description: The signed-in principal may not write that table. It is logged and administrators are alerted.
errors.fix: Use the proper feature; if it was legitimate, an administrator should look at the activity log.

errors.title: That would leave no active super admin
errors.description: The database itself refuses to remove the last active super admin.
errors.fix: Create or reactivate another super admin first.

two_step_verification.about: TOTP second factor for super admins' dangerous actions.

errors.title: A code is needed
errors.description: Two-step verification applies to this account: enter the authenticator code (or a recovery code) as well as the password.

errors.title: That code is not right
errors.description: The code does not match the secret, or the phone's clock is off.
errors.fix: Use the newest code; check the phone's time.

errors.title: Already set up
errors.description: Turn it off before setting it up again.

errors.title: No set-up in progress
errors.description: Finish needs a started set-up.

errors.title: Set up two-step verification first
errors.description: Policy dual_control.mfa_required: a super admin who has not enrolled cannot request or approve.

errors.title: It cannot be turned off
errors.description: Policy dual_control.mfa_required makes it mandatory.
errors.fix: Only root's policy can change this.

dual_control.about: Requests that need a second super admin.

errors.title: A second super admin's approval is needed
errors.description: This action needs an approved request first (policy dual_control.enabled).
errors.fix: Request it on the System page; another super admin approves.

errors.title: That approval is not for this action
errors.description: The approval is for a different action or parameters, or was requested by someone else.
errors.fix: Request a new one for this exact action.

errors.title: Not approved yet
errors.description: The request is still pending or was denied.

errors.title: The delay has not passed
errors.description: Policy dual_control.delay_minutes holds an approved action back.

errors.title: The approval expired
errors.description: It was not used within dual_control.expiry_minutes.

errors.title: Already decided
errors.description: The request is already approved, denied or executed.

errors.title: A different super admin must approve
errors.description: You cannot approve your own request unless you are the only active super admin and policy allows it.

errors.title: Password or code not correct
errors.description: The re-entered password, the authenticator code, or an already used code was wrong. Counts towards the lock-out.

errors.title: Step-up is locked for a while
errors.description: Five wrong passwords or codes in 15 minutes.

errors.title: Unknown action
errors.description: The action name is not one dual control knows.
errors.fix: Use one of the listed actions.

errors.title: Choose an existing backup
errors.description: The backup named in the request does not exist.

errors.title: Switched off by root's policy
errors.description: A policy flag (for example system.reset_everything_allowed) forbids this.
errors.fix: Only root's policy can change it.

errors.title: Type the confirmation
errors.description: A dangerous action needs the exact phrase or name typed.

policy_and_flags.about: Global policy control, launch flags and features.

errors.title: Switched off
errors.description: A feature (or OTA) was switched off by root or an administrator.
errors.fix: Ask who switched it off; root's launch flags cannot be undone from the web.

errors.title: Locked at a higher level
errors.description: Whoever set the feature last has more authority than you, or locked it.

errors.title: Unknown policy flag
errors.description: No flag has that name.

errors.title: Not a valid value for that flag
errors.description: The value has the wrong type or is outside the flag's range.

errors.title: You may not change this flag
errors.description: Only root changes policy flags; super admins may change the few marked operational; administrators and faculty none.

errors.title: That would loosen the hardened profile
errors.description: In the hardened profile an override may only make a flag safer.
errors.fix: Sign a policy file with scripts/gpc.py.

errors.title: Flags that cannot work together
errors.description: Two or more flags contradict each other. At start-up this stops imPress before anything else.
errors.fix: Change one of the named flags.

errors.title: The policy store was edited outside imPress
errors.description: The sealed policy file did not verify. It was set aside and the defaults restored; an alert and an audit entry were made.
errors.fix: Change policy through the console or the System page only.

errors.title: A signed policy file was refused
errors.description: Bad signature, wrong key, an old serial, or an unknown flag. Never half-applied.

errors.title: The flags file cannot be applied
errors.description: impress.flags.json is not valid JSON, names an unknown flag, or has a wrong value. imPress does not start.

errors.title: That is a policy flag
errors.description: Security and integrity flags are kept in the sealed policy store, not in the flags file.

errors.title: Root's password is needed
errors.description: This is a sensitive root action (rehash, policy change, reset, ...).

errors.title: Root's password is not correct
errors.description: Wrong password. Repeated failures slow down.

errors.title: The separate root console is closed here
errors.description: Policy root.allow_access is off (TrustedInstaller closes it in a container).
errors.fix: Use the console on the container's own screen.

errors.title: A console command failed
errors.description: The command's message says why; nothing was half-done.

errors.title: Unknown console command
errors.description: No such command.

database_integrity.about: Seals, verification, backups and test mode.

errors.title: The database does not verify
errors.description: A seal does not match: something changed the database outside imPress. It is Degraded.
errors.fix: Resolve the Degraded state first (System page).

errors.title: The database is Degraded
errors.description: An automatic restore or an unresolved alarm is pending acknowledgement.
errors.fix: A super admin acknowledges it on the System page.

errors.title: The database is busy
errors.description: Another process holds a write lock longer than the busy timeout; nothing was saved.

errors.title: The sealing key changed
errors.description: IMPRESS_JWT_SECRET was rotated; the database is re-sealed as it is and an alert is raised.

errors.title: That backup does not verify
errors.description: The copy's seals do not match: it is never accepted.

errors.title: That backup cannot be used
errors.description: SQLite cannot read it, or its own integrity check failed.

errors.title: No such backup
errors.description: The id does not exist.

errors.title: Only saved backups can be deleted
errors.description: Automatic copies manage themselves.
errors.fix: Delete only the ones you saved.

errors.title: That name is not allowed
errors.description: 1-48 letters, digits, spaces, dot, underscore, dash.

errors.title: That name exists already
errors.description: A backup or dataset has that name.

errors.title: No backups in test mode
errors.description: Backups are neither made nor restored while test mode is on.

errors.title: Test mode is off
errors.description: Test data routes need test mode.
errors.fix: A super admin turns test mode on.

errors.title: Test mode was enabled by root
errors.description: It cannot be turned off from the web app.

errors.title: Test mode is already on
errors.description: Nothing to do: test mode is already in the state you asked for.

errors.title: Test mode is not on
errors.description: Nothing to do: test mode is already in the state you asked for.

errors.title: The saved real database was changed
errors.description: Its checksum no longer matches; test mode stays on.
errors.fix: Restore the real data from a backup.

errors.title: The restore does not verify
errors.description: The real database was put back but fails verification: Degraded.

errors.title: No such saved dataset
errors.description: The name does not exist.

errors.title: No such test data
errors.description: Nothing waits under that id.

errors.title: Rows are not valid
errors.description: Per-cell errors are listed; nothing was imported (all or nothing).

integrity_protection.about: IIPS: the program's own files, and the device they belong to.

errors.title: imPress is disabled by Root
errors.description: The program's files differ from the reference (changed, added, removed or moved).
errors.fix: Restore the files, or root restarts with --rehash (root's password).

errors.title: The files were made on another device
errors.description: The reference was sealed for a different machine: the code or its reference was copied.
errors.fix: Root re-hashes on this machine (root's password).

errors.title: The integrity reference was edited
errors.description: Its seal does not verify.

errors.title: Integrity protection is off
errors.description: Started with --bypass-iips or iips.enabled=false: every page shows a warning.

errors.title: Locked: the host is being verified
errors.description: TrustedInstaller has not finished, or a critical requirement fails.

errors.title: The code differs from the signed manifest
errors.description: A file does not match MANIFEST.json (policy code.verify_manifest).
errors.fix: Reinstall, or root signs a new manifest.

errors.title: That username or email is taken
errors.description: Usernames and emails are unique.

errors.title: No such account
errors.description: The id or name does not exist.

errors.title: Past the 30 days
errors.description: A deleted account can be restored for 30 days only.

errors.title: The CSV could not be imported
errors.description: A header is missing or a row is invalid; nothing was imported.

classroom.about: Classes, courses, students, quizzes and polls.

errors.title: No such class
errors.description: It does not exist, or you have no access.

errors.title: Class code in use
errors.description: Class codes are unique.

errors.title: The class is not active
errors.description: Quizzes, polls and device traffic need an activated class.

errors.title: No such student
errors.description: The id or roll number does not exist.

errors.title: Roll number in use
errors.description: Roll numbers are unique.

errors.title: No such quiz
errors.description: Does not exist or not yours.

errors.title: The quiz is not in that state
errors.description: For example starting a quiz that is already running or finished.

errors.title: The poll is not in that state
errors.description: For example voting on a closed poll.

errors.title: Already answered
errors.description: One press is one stored answer.

errors.title: The timetable is unknown or stale
errors.description: Room-occupancy questions fail closed when the timetable is older than SCHEDULE_MAX_AGE_HOURS.

devices_and_firmware.about: Gateways, hubs, student modules, firmware and OTA.

errors.title: Bad device key
errors.description: A device presented a wrong or unknown key.

errors.title: The shared device key may only enrol
errors.description: Policy device.keys_required.
errors.fix: Re-enrol the device to get its own key.

errors.title: Devices must use TLS
errors.description: Policy device.https_required.

errors.title: Image is not signed with the site key
errors.description: A site signing key is configured and the image lacks a valid signature.

errors.title: TrustedInstaller has not qualified this image
errors.description: Only qualified images can be approved or deployed.

errors.title: The uploader cannot approve
errors.description: Another administrator must approve (unless FIRMWARE_SINGLE_APPROVER).

errors.title: Managed by an authoritative source
errors.description: The timetable source owns that data.

errors.title: Over-the-air updates are off
errors.description: Policy ota.enabled is false (--no-ota).

errors.title: Outside the maintenance window
errors.description: S3/C6 updates wait for classroom downtime unless a super admin overrides.

errors.title: The deployment is not in that state
errors.description: For example pausing a finished deployment.

errors.title: Unusual traffic
errors.description: A rate limit per endpoint, address or account was exceeded; administrators are alerted. Nobody is blocked.
errors.fix: Check the alert on the System page.

errors.title: WebSocket refused
errors.description: A live connection without a valid token or device key (close code 4401).

errors.title: WebSocket not allowed for that class
errors.description: A live connection is bound to classes you may access (close code 4403).

startup.about: Why imPress did not start. Exit codes of `python -m app.serve`.

errors.title: Exit code 2: configuration refused
errors.description: A flag, the flags file or the policy cannot be applied; a conflict between flags; default secrets outside debug mode; the hardened profile below its floor.
errors.fix: Read the message printed before exit; fix and restart.

errors.title: Exit code 3: integrity lock
errors.description: The program's files changed, were copied from another device, or the reference was edited.
errors.fix: Root restarts with --rehash and enters root's password.

errors.title: Exit code 4: the console is closed
errors.description: Policy root.allow_access is off here.
errors.fix: Use the console on the container's screen.

errors.title: Flags that conflict
errors.description: Two or more flags contradict each other. This is checked before anything else; nothing else is verified or started.
errors.fix: Change one of the named flags.

errors.title: Below the hardened floor
errors.description: The hardened profile refuses to start with debug on, default secrets, no HTTPS, an unsigned-firmware allowance, no audit sink and so on.
errors.fix: Fix the listed items or run the standard profile.

errors.title: Default secrets
errors.description: IMPRESS_JWT_SECRET or IMPRESS_DEVICE_API_KEY is still the public default.
errors.fix: Run the launcher (it generates them) or set your own.

errors.title: Port 8000 is busy
errors.description: Another process listens there.
errors.fix: The launcher shows it and asks before stopping it.

errors.title: A schema migration could not apply
errors.description: Start-up stops rather than run on a half-migrated database; a copy was made first.
errors.fix: Restore the copy named in the log.

errors.title: The host does not meet a requirement
errors.description: Python, SQLite or a writable data folder are critical; memory, disk, cores switch features off.

hardware.about: Faults reported by gateways, hubs and student modules (shown on the Devices page and in diagnostics).

errors.title: S3-C6 link lost
errors.description: The SPI link between hub and gateway stopped answering.
errors.fix: Check wiring and power; the gateway reports reset reasons.

errors.title: Brown-out reset
errors.description: The supply dipped below the brown-out threshold.
errors.fix: Use a better supply or cable.

errors.title: Watchdog reset
errors.description: The firmware did not feed the watchdog.
errors.fix: Report the boot counter and reset reason.

errors.title: An OTA image was rolled back
errors.description: The new image did not report healthy within 120 s.

errors.title: Mesh frame over the payload budget
errors.description: ESP-NOW payload limit (238 bytes) exceeded.

errors.title: Flashing failed
errors.description: esptool could not write the image (port busy, wrong chip, a boot-mode button).
errors.fix: Hold BOOT, check the port with `ports`, retry.
